I agree that it shouldn't continue once the site is bigger, but people are purposefully impersonating individuals. Not just taking their usernames, but speaking as if they are that person, which is highly distasteful and could have some serious implications.

Since user information isn't collected, any person could pretend to be someone and post illegal materials, and who do the authorities go to if whoaverse doesn't have what they're looking for? If there was ever an investigation, they would probably try to get reddit to hand over info on the account with a matching username. Especially when all the evidence points to that user making an account on whoaverse after discovering it on reddit.

I'm not saying it will happen, but it's within the scope of reality, and that is enough to either reassign the usernames, or start logging user info.

And I really don't feel sorry for the people who are intentionally impersonating people, or using bots to create accounts in mass. If someone grabs a username and participates in the same communities as the person in reddit, intentionally making them look bad, then the original account holder on reddit says, "Hey whoaverse admins, this person is impersonating me using my username and I would like it to stop", I think they're well within their rights to do so. I don't see that scenario as a matter of "first-come-first-serve", I see it as identity theft for the purposes of character defamation.

However, if someone makes a parody account that is obviously not the original account holder on reddit, and they use it to make fun of the original account/account holder on reddit, that is fine.

But the second someone is actually trying to convince someone that they are the original account holder, through spoken word or without disclosing that they are not in fact the original account holder if asked, then there is a problem.

It should be investigated on a case by case basis until the site gains traction. I mean, so long as we get users mostly from reddit, there will be the problem of users impersonating power-users to try to do stupid shit.
